scope: E — Reproductive / Breast first-learning cognition, Source contact, retrieval closure, compression and repair return
medical_core_owner: 20 canonical Block Markdown files under content/xizong/knowledge/systems/e-reproductive-breast/sr-sr1-sr6/ and e-e1-e14/
role: System-specific Learning candidate. It may decide learner order, Source-contact granularity, Logic Groups, retrieval closure and compression but may not rewrite accepted E medical Knowledge.
rule: Preserve the accepted two-trunk E Knowledge model while minimizing switching and false prerequisites. Every canonical KP is retrieved exactly once inside one local Logic Group; Logic Group count never determines Source-contact count.

classes.WHOLE_BLOCK_SOURCE: one compact coherent Current Source unit may be consumed continuously before local retrieval
classes.NATURAL_SOURCE_UNITS: a multi-center, multi-source or visual-dense Block uses a small number of genuine Source units; each Source unit may support several Logic Groups

source_contact_contract.hard_rule: Logic Group count never determines Source-contact count. VISUAL_REQUIRED is a closure/evidence requirement, not automatically a separate device handoff.

units: endocrine common-language refresh + reproductive control-axis entry

visual_contract.rule: When the decisive relation is spatial or morphologic, first formation requires real original-Source visual contact. Text may orient or later test retrieval but cannot certify a never-seen visual model.
visual_contract.fail_closed_rule: A visual_required LG whose Current visual source is GAP/PARTIAL may remain semantically valid Learning but cannot be treated as visually mastered from prose or KianOS rendering alone.

negative_space: no complete obstetrics/gynecology clinical curriculum or modern infertility/PCOS/obstetric-management expansion
no complete male reproductive clinical curriculum; prostate/urinary Primary remains outside E
no full breast imaging/pathology specialty curriculum, BI-RADS or reconstructive pathway
no silent modernization of Current-Study FIGO/AJCC/staging/treatment/drug wording
no duplicate generic HPV/STI/infection Primary or tumor-general/molecular-biology Primary
no model-prior completion of E7 Source Gap or E9/E10/E11 visual gaps
no inferred official E System question membership or Question→Knowledge mapping while S2 remains UNTESTED
no learner-state or mastery claim from repository construction

repair_return.visual_relation_missing: return to original visual Source; if Current Source is still gap/partial, preserve the debt rather than certify mastery
repair_return.source_gap_or_version_conflict: Current Source-context check; do not resolve by model prior or modern guideline substitution
repair_return.return_rule: after repair, return to the interrupted E mainline; repair evidence does not erase the original observation and does not prove mastery

external_readiness.endocrine_common: reactivate smallest necessary feedback/receptor/steroid baseline when missing
external_readiness.infection_common: reactivate only the generic infection/source-control language needed for E11
external_readiness.tumor_common: reactivate only the generic atypia/in-situ/invasion/spread/evidence language needed by the current organ-specific Block
external_readiness.prostate_urinary: interface only; never become E hard readiness

system_route.hard_edge_rule: A hard edge is allowed only if the later Block intentionally consumes an already-formed E model, does not rebuild it, and bounded reactivation is insufficient. Current E candidate finds no inside-E edge meeting that bar; this zero-hard-edge claim is a required fresh-audit target.
system_route.flex_rule: The default route is low-switching guidance across physiology → reproductive pathology → low-connectivity surgery/benign breast → breast malignancy. Earlier E Blocks frequently improve later compression, but every Current E Block retains enough accepted Primary Source to form honestly with bounded reactivation. Useful order, Source continuity and comparison value are not hard legality.

first_pass_chain: System orientation in KianOS using the accepted two-trunk E Knowledge model
bounded Block / natural Source-unit orientation and stop-line
continuous original Lecture contact in iPad/MarginNote for genuine new Source learning and original visuals
one normal return after the relevant Source contact rather than one handoff per Logic Group
active KP retrieval by accepted Logic-Group learner order
Logic-Group closure; visual-required groups need real visual contact and may remain source-debt when Current visual evidence is missing
after all Block LGs close: Block Recall
optional non-gating Partial-System Reconstruction at natural branch checkpoints
after all 20 Blocks are actually learned: final E System Reconstruction
trusted official E System question sweep only after S2 exact official-question membership separately closes
Wrong / Uncertain then returns through the smallest failed LG, visual Source, precision object or external owner

partial_system_reconstructions.target: controller → gonadal cell/gamete execution → cycle state → pregnancy rescue/placental takeover → lactation production/ejection
partial_system_reconstructions.closure: rebuild one time-dependent reproductive control chain without reciting six Block titles

partial_system_reconstructions.target: normal compartment/lineage → location/type/growth change → barrier breach? → metastatic competence/spread? → evidence
partial_system_reconstructions.closure: classify a new reproductive pathology by lineage + operation + invasion/spread as separate variables

partial_system_reconstructions.target: normal duct/lobule/myoepithelium → benign symptom or stasis/infection vs clonal progression → local/regional/distant evidence → receptor/stage → local/regional/systemic treatment objective
partial_system_reconstructions.closure: route a new breast presentation by structure, disease identity, extent/evidence and treatment objective rather than one surface sign

SR2.goal: androgen metabolism, feedback and DHT/local conversion

SR2.goal: sperm maturation, capacitation and acrosome reaction with explicit boundary to later clinical owners

SR3.goal: E/P effects across endometrium, myometrium, cervix, tube, vagina, breast and systemic interfaces

SR3.goal: organ-operation consequences and closed-book cycle algorithm

SR5.goal: fertilization entry and the binary fate of the corpus luteum/cycle

SR5.goal: placental hormone roles and fetal-placental E3 cooperation
SR5.closure: match hCG/hPL/E3/P to source and function without treating them as one pregnancy-hormone list

SR5.goal: uterine quiescence/parturition boundary and whole relay compression

SR6.goal: normal duct-lobule-myoepithelial unit and E/P developmental roles

E1.closure: distinguish location change from cell-type change before calling a lesion

E1.goal: chronic inflammation outputs: polyp, retention cyst and reverse localization
E1.closure: given red/protruding/cystic appearance, infer the structural operation without upgrading it to malignancy

E2.closure: state the organ-specific HPV→cell-cycle chain without rebuilding generic HPV/infection medicine

E2.goal: site/lineage plus in-situ, microinvasive and invasive boundary

E2.goal: spread routes, Current-Study stage language and reverse algorithm

compression.ladder: 212 KP → 67 LG → 20 Block Recall → 3 non-gating PSR → final E System Reconstruction
compression.block_recall_rule: rebuild the governing reproductive/breast problem; do not recite KP labels

final_system_reconstruction.target: two coupled trunks: control/time plus tissue/compartment identity; then route location/type/growth, invasion, spread, evidence and treatment objective while keeping E9 as a low-connectivity developmental surgical interface
forbidden: treat default route as medical ontology
collapse local invasion into metastatic competence
claim visual mastery from prose-only recall
import missing obstetrics/gynecology, male reproductive, breast-specialty or modern-guideline content

compression.second_pass: decisive discriminations + high-value morphology/visual relations + precision + cases + Wrong/Uncertain/fresh verification; do not replay all 67 LGs by default
compression.late_review: two-trunk mother model + three PSR skeletons + decisive lineage/invasion/spread distinctions + visual/precision/version boundaries + real personal weak points

inputs: B/endocrine/metabolic: feedback, steroid synthesis/receptor and shared endocrine language
C/infection/immunity: generic infection/source-control and HPV/STI interfaces
A3/urinary: prostate/urinary Primary remains outside E
general pathology/tumor owners: metaplasia, atypia, in-situ/invasion, generic spread/evidence language

cross_system_handoff.fine_grain_rule: System-level interfaces are allowed; finer external Block/KP routing fails closed without separately reviewed Current authority.

requirements_if_later_eligible: support explicit per-Block Logic-Group membership without assuming equal group size
support mixed whole-Block and natural-Source-unit contact without per-LG bouncing
carry visual-required/source-gap state without inventing visual mastery
keep default route guidance separate from hard legality
preserve Current-Study version boundaries and fail-closed question membership
projection_boundary.rule: Projection may not rewrite E Learning Logic to fit a contiguous-range loader, existing page order or renderer schema.
